digest.component_or_area: metrics / code_health lens / scc LOC analyzer adapter
propositions: scc LOC analyzer must invoke scc via subprocess with --format json and parse per-file Code and Location fields from JSON output
analyzer must return AnalyzerResult with loc payload containing repo-relative POSIX-normalized file paths as keys and LOC counts as values, plus max_loc
analyzer must fail closed (return Unavailable with reason and _ACCRUING_SINCE) when scc binary is missing, exits non-zero, produces empty/unparseable stdout, without fabricating zeros
analyzer must treat successful empty output (no files) as valid result with empty files dict and max_loc=0, not as unavailable
scc_loc.py must be self-contained in analyzers/ package without importing from grounding layer, using injectable run parameter for testability
